title: First shields
blurb: Draw a roof. The bees will check your work.

title: Bad ground
blurb: Water, lava and holes. The ink has to stand on something.

title: Tight spots
blurb: Little ink, and places it cannot go.

title: Blades
blurb: Saws cut ink. Draw where they are not.

title: Fire
blurb: Ink burns. Bees will not cross a flame.

title: Things fall
blurb: Boulders, bombs and ice. Watch the rings.
